scripts.generate:api: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir apps/web generate:api
scripts.format: uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api && pnpm --dir apps/web format
scripts.check: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
